salmanshh_advdrunkenwalkers.name: Advanced Drunken Walkers
salmanshh_advdrunkenwalkers.description: Seeded drunkard's-walk generation engine. Carves organic maps with configurable walkers and scatters tagged marks - logic only, you draw the result.

gridWidth.name: Grid Width
gridWidth.desc: Grid width in cells. The grid is built at this size automatically when the layout starts - Create Grid is only needed for a different size.

gridHeight.name: Grid Height
gridHeight.desc: Grid height in cells. The grid is built at this size automatically when the layout starts - Create Grid is only needed for a different size.

maxGridSize.name: Max Grid Size
maxGridSize.desc: Hard cap on both axes. Create Grid clamps to this and warns in debug mode - a safety net against runaway expressions.

cellSize.name: Cell Size
cellSize.desc: Pixel size of one cell, used by the cell to layout coordinate expressions.

originX.name: Origin X
originX.desc: Layout X of the grid's top-left corner, for the coordinate expressions.

originY.name: Origin Y
originY.desc: Layout Y of the grid's top-left corner, for the coordinate expressions.

emptyValue.name: Empty Value
emptyValue.desc: The value the grid is filled with on creation and by Clear Grid.

seed.name: Seed
seed.desc: Initial seed. Leave empty to derive one from the current time (non-deterministic until Set Seed is called).

randomSource.name: Random Source
randomSource.desc: Where random values come from: the built-in seeded PRNG, or the queue filled by Inject Random.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.desc: Log walker lifecycles, re-rolled boundary steps, clamped grid sizes and injected-queue underruns to the browser console.

ClearGrid.description: Fill every cell with the given value without touching walkers, marks or the random stream. Does not fire On Cell Carved.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value written into every cell.

CreateGrid.description: Only needed for a size other than the Grid Width and Grid Height properties - the grid those describe already exists when the layout starts. Allocates a fresh grid filled with the Empty Value, clamped to Max Grid Size. Pass a negative for either dimension to fall back to that property. Destroys any previous grid, walkers and marks.

width.name: Width
width.desc: Grid width in cells. Negative falls back to the Grid Width property.

height.name: Height
height.desc: Grid height in cells. Negative falls back to the Grid Height property.

SetCell.description: Write one cell directly, useful for pre-placing anchors before walkers run. Does not fire On Cell Carved.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

SetOrigin.display-text: {my} set grid origin to ([i]{0}[/i], [i]{1}[/i]) with cell size [i]{2}[/i]
SetOrigin.description: Reposition the grid in layout space for the coordinate expressions. Pass 0 for the cell size to keep the current value.

x.name: X
x.desc: Layout X of the grid's top-left corner.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Layout Y of the grid's top-left corner.

cellSize.name: Cell Size
cellSize.desc: Pixel size of one cell, or 0 to keep the current value.

ClearMarks.description: Remove all marks with the tag. An empty string removes every mark.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag to clear, or empty to clear every mark.

DropMarksAlongWalk.display-text: {my} drop [i]{1}[/i] marks along walker [b]{0}[/b] every [i]{2}[/i] steps, chance [i]{3}[/i], min spacing [i]{4}[/i]
DropMarksAlongWalk.description: Place tagged marks along a walker's recorded path: a candidate every N steps, kept with the given 0-1 chance, discarded when it lands within min spacing cells of a same-tag mark. Fires On Mark Placed per mark.

walkerId.name: Walker ID
walkerId.desc: The walker whose path to walk along.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag given to every mark placed by this pass.

everySteps.name: Every Steps
everySteps.desc: Consider a candidate every N steps of the walk.

chance.name: Chance
chance.desc: Probability from 0 to 1 that a candidate is kept.

minSpacing.name: Min Spacing
minSpacing.desc: Minimum distance in cells between two marks of this tag. 0 still prevents two marks stacking on one cell.

ScatterMarks.display-text: {my} scatter [i]{1}[/i] [i]{0}[/i] marks on cells valued [i]{2}[/i], placement [i]{3}[/i], min spacing [i]{4}[/i]
ScatterMarks.description: Deterministically scatter up to count tagged marks onto cells holding the value. Interior requires all 8 neighbours to match (open areas), edge requires at least one that does not (against walls). Fires On Mark Placed per mark.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag given to every mark placed by this pass.

count.name: Count
count.desc: How many marks to place at most.

cellValue.name: Cell Value
cellValue.desc: Only cells holding this value are eligible.

minSpacing.name: Min Spacing
minSpacing.desc: Minimum distance in cells between two marks of this tag. 0 still prevents two marks stacking on one cell.

DilateCells.description: Expand every region of the given value outward by one cell per iteration, widening corridors into chambers. Any cell with an 8-way neighbour holding the value is converted. Fires On Cell Carved for each newly converted cell.

iterations.name: Iterations
iterations.desc: How many times to expand by one cell.

OutlineCells.description: Write the outline value into every Empty Value cell adjacent 8-way to a cell holding the value - the classic put walls around the floor pass. Fires On Cell Carved for each written cell.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value to outline, for example your floor value.

outlineValue.name: Outline Value
outlineValue.desc: The value written into the surrounding empty cells.

InjectRandom.description: Queue one 0-1 value for injected mode, for example AdvancedRandom.Random. A queue underrun during generation falls back to the internal PRNG and warns in debug mode.

SetRandomSource.description: Switch where random values come from. In injected mode generation consumes the queue filled by Inject Random, which routes every decision through another plugin's stream.

SetSeed.description: Reset the internal PRNG with this seed. Call it before generation: the same seed with the same action order reproduces identical output. Pass AdvancedRandom.Seed here to share one master seed with the Advanced Random plugin.

seed.name: Seed
seed.desc: Seed string. Empty derives one from the current time.

AddWalker.display-text: {my} add walker [b]{0}[/b] at ([i]{1}[/i], [i]{2}[/i]), [i]{3}[/i] steps, [i]{4}[/i] directions, max turn [i]{5}[/i], tag [i]{6}[/i], carving [i]{7}[/i]
AddWalker.description: Register a walker with the given core settings, including the value it carves. Remaining fields use the Walker Definition defaults. Walkers run in registration order.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: Unique ID for this walker. Re-using an ID replaces that walker in place.

startX.name: Start X
startX.desc: Starting cell X, 0 at the left edge.

startY.name: Start Y
startY.desc: Starting cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

directions.name: Directions
directions.desc: Allowed headings, 1 to 8, evenly spaced from the start angle. 4 gives cardinal corridors, 8 allows diagonals, 1 walks a straight line.

maxTurn.name: Max Turn
maxTurn.desc: Largest heading change per step in degrees, 0 to 180. Low values wind smoothly, 180 gives classic jittery caves.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Groups walkers for Run Walkers By Tag. Empty for untagged.

carveValue.name: Carve Value
carveValue.desc: The integer this walker writes into every cell it visits. Give each walker its own value to layer floors, water, ore and decoration in one grid, then read them back per value.

DefineWalker.description: Register a walker from a full Walker Definition JSON string, for example {"id":"cave","startX":32,"startY":32,"steps":400,"directions":8,"maxTurn":180,"startAngle":0,"turnChance":1,"carveValue":1,"brushSize":1,"tag":""}. Replaces any existing walker with the same id.

definition.name: Definition
definition.desc: Walker Definition as a JSON string. Only id, startX and startY are required.

RemoveWalker.description: Unregister the walker. Cells it already carved are unaffected.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to remove.

RunAllWalkers.description: Execute every registered walker to the end of its step budget, in registration order, firing On Cell Carved per newly carved cell and On Walker Finished per walker, then On Generation Complete.

RunWalker.description: Execute one walker to completion, firing its carve and finish triggers. Does not fire On Generation Complete.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to run.

RunWalkersByTag.description: Execute every registered walker carrying the tag, in registration order, then fire On Walkers By Tag Complete. Lets you stage generation in passes. An empty tag runs only untagged walkers.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Walker tag to run. Empty runs only untagged walkers.

SetWalkerCarveValue.description: Change the integer a walker writes into the cells it visits. It applies from the walker's next step, so cells it has already carved keep their old value. Set it before running the walker to pick that walker's terrain, or change it mid-run from On Walker Stepped to lay down two values along one path.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to change.

value.name: Carve Value
value.desc: The integer written into every cell the walker visits from now on.

SetWalkerDigSize.display-text: {my} set walker [b]{0}[/b] dig size to [i]{1}[/i] wide by [i]{2}[/i] deep
SetWalkerDigSize.description: Make a walker dig out a rectangle that turns with it instead of a fixed square. Width is measured across the direction it faces, so it is the corridor width, and is always centred. Depth is measured along that direction and is signed: a positive digs forward from the walker's own cell, a negative digs behind it, and either way its own cell is included, so 1 and -1 both mean just that cell. A walker facing right digs a corridor width cells tall, and the same walker facing down digs one width cells wide. Pass 0 for a dimension to fall back to the walker's brush size for that axis, and 0 for both to restore the plain square brush.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to resize.

width.name: Width
width.desc: Cells across the direction the walker faces, so the corridor width. Always centred. 0 uses the brush size.

depth.name: Depth
depth.desc: Cells along the direction the walker faces. Positive digs ahead of the walker, negative digs behind it, and its own cell is always included. 0 uses the brush size.

SetWalkerDirectionWeights.description: Bias which way a walker turns. Weights are relative, comma separated, one per direction in direction order: entry 0 is the walker's start angle and the rest follow it clockwise. A weight of 0 rules a direction out, and any entry you leave off counts as 1. Missing directions still apply, so "3,1,1" on an 8 direction walker weights the first three and leaves the other five at 1. Leave the string empty to go back to equal weights.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to weight.

weights.name: Weights
weights.desc: Comma separated relative weights in direction order, e.g. "4,2,1,0,0,0,1,2". Empty restores equal weights.

StepWalker.description: Advance one walker by up to N steps, the animated-generation path. Fires On Walker Stepped per step and On Walker Finished when the budget is exhausted.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: ID of the walker to step.

steps.name: Steps
steps.desc: How many steps to advance at most.

IsCellValue.description: True if the cell holds exactly the given value. Out-of-bounds cells match nothing.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

IsInsideGrid.description: True if the coordinates fall within the current grid.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

HasMarkAt.description: True if a mark with the tag sits on that cell. An empty tag matches any mark.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Mark tag to look for, or empty for any mark.

OnMarkPlaced.description: Fires once per mark from Drop Marks Along Walk and Scatter Marks. Use MarkX, MarkY and MarkTag inside. An empty filter matches all tags.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Mark tag to match, or empty for any tag.

HasWalker.description: True if a walker with the id is currently registered.

OnCellCarved.description: Fires once per cell whose value changes during walker runs, dilation or outlining. Use CarvedX, CarvedY, CarvedValue and WalkerID inside. On big grids prefer iterating results after generation over per-cell spawning here.

OnGenerationComplete.description: Fires after Run All Walkers finishes every walker. The idiomatic place to run mark passes and paint your tilemap via the Count and Index expressions.

OnWalkerFinished.description: Fires when a walker exhausts its step budget or runs out of legal moves. WalkerX and WalkerY give its final cell, useful for chaining the next walker onto this one's endpoint. An empty filter matches all walkers.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: Walker ID to match, or empty for any walker.

OnWalkersByTagComplete.description: Fires after a Run Walkers By Tag call finishes its whole batch. The batch tag is readable via WalkerTag inside. An empty filter matches any batch.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Batch tag to match, or empty for any batch.

OnWalkerStepped.description: Fires after each step of Step Walker only, batch runs skip it for speed. WalkerX, WalkerY, WalkerAngle and WalkerStepsLeft are valid inside. An empty filter matches all walkers.

walkerId.name: ID
walkerId.desc: Walker ID to match, or empty for any walker.

CellToLayoutX.description: Layout X of the cell's centre, from Origin X and Cell Size.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

CellToLayoutY.description: Layout Y of the cell's centre, from Origin Y and Cell Size.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

CellValue.description: Value at the cell. Returns the Empty Value for out-of-bounds queries.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

CountCells.description: Total cells currently holding the value. Pairs with GetCellXByIndex and GetCellYByIndex to iterate results.

GetCellXByIndex.description: X of the index-th cell holding the value, 0-based in a stable left-to-right, top-to-bottom order. Returns -1 when out of range.

GetCellYByIndex.description: Y of the index-th cell holding the value, 0-based in a stable left-to-right, top-to-bottom order. Returns -1 when out of range.

LayoutToX.description: Cell X containing the layout X coordinate. May fall outside the grid.

LayoutToY.description: Cell Y containing the layout Y coordinate. May fall outside the grid.

NeighbourCount.description: How many of the 8 neighbours hold the given value, handy for autotiling and custom placement rules. Off-grid neighbours never match.

x.name: X
x.desc: Cell X, 0 at the left edge.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Cell Y, 0 at the top edge.

CountMarks.description: Marks with the tag. An empty tag counts every mark. Pairs with GetMarkXByIndex and GetMarkYByIndex to iterate results.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Mark tag, or empty for all marks.

GetMarkXByIndex.description: X of the index-th mark with the tag, 0-based in placement order. Returns -1 when out of range.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Mark tag, or empty for all marks.

GetMarkYByIndex.description: Y of the index-th mark with the tag, 0-based in placement order. Returns -1 when out of range.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Mark tag, or empty for all marks.

MarkTag.description: Tag of the mark just placed, inside On Mark Placed.

MarkX.description: X of the mark just placed, inside On Mark Placed.

MarkY.description: Y of the mark just placed, inside On Mark Placed.

CurrentSeed.description: The seed the PRNG was last set with.

CarvedValue.description: Value just written into the cell, inside On Cell Carved.

CarvedX.description: X of the cell just written, inside On Cell Carved.

CarvedY.description: Y of the cell just written, inside On Cell Carved.

WalkerAngle.description: Current heading of the triggering walker in degrees, 0 = right and 90 = down. Reads 0 outside walker triggers.

WalkerID.description: ID of the triggering walker, inside walker triggers and On Cell Carved. Empty for post-processing passes and outside triggers.

WalkerStepsLeft.description: Remaining step budget of the triggering walker. Reads 0 outside walker triggers.

WalkerTag.description: Tag of the triggering walker, inside walker triggers and On Cell Carved, or the batch tag inside On Walkers By Tag Complete.

WalkerX.description: Current X of the triggering walker. Reads 0 outside walker triggers.

WalkerY.description: Current Y of the triggering walker. Reads 0 outside walker triggers.
